2124814390943965680.en_summary: $CRWD has agreed to acquire $ZS in an all-stock deal for $43.9 billion, surpassing Google's $32B acquisition of Wiz as the largest cybersecurity acquisition. Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares per share, valuing ZS at approximately $260, a 34% premium to Friday's close. Combined company will have more than $10B in ARR. CrowdStrike says the deal adds over $185B to its addressable market and creates cross-sell opportunities to roughly 8,000 Zscaler customers.
2124814390943965680.zh_summary: $CRWD 已同意以全股票交易收購 $ZS，交易金額為439億美元，超越谷歌320億美元收購Wiz，成為史上最大網路安全收購案。Zscaler股東每股將獲得1.135股CrowdStrike股票，使ZS估值約為260美元，較周五收盤價溢價34%。合併公司將擁有超過100億美元的年度經常性收入。CrowdStrike表示該交易將其可觸及市場增加超過1850億美元，並為約8000名Zscaler客戶創造交叉銷售機會。

ticker_notes.CRWD: Acquiring ZS for $43.9B all-stock, adds >$185B TAM and ~8,000 customers, >$10B ARR combined
ticker_notes.ZS: Acquired by CRWD at ~$260 per share (34% premium), 1.135 CRWD shares per ZS share
